description: Read submission-deadline changes for one watched TED tender. Use tenders_list_watched first; use funding_list_changes for funding calls and compliance_list_deadlines for statutory deadlines. Returns events per lot with old/new local and UTC deadlines, official TED notice links, current deadlines and freshness. Replay next_cursor to page, checkpoint_cursor to poll; cursors belong to that notice. Unknown watches return notice_not_tracked. Read-only; no MCP payment flow. Without a key, 10 successful answers/day are free; an optional API key uses existing prepaid credits. Exhaustion returns an error with the HTTP alternative.

cursor.description: Opaque signed base64url next_cursor or checkpoint_cursor for this same notice, 20 to 400 ASCII letters/digits/_/-. Copy unchanged; refresh within 24 hours; omit on first call. Example illustrates syntax only, not a valid signature.

notice_id.description: TED publication number of the watched tender, e.g. 662865-2026

name: tenders_list_deadline_changes
title: List TED tender deadline changes
